import json
data = json.load\(open\('portfolio_images.json'\)\)
php_items = []
for item in data:
    name = item['name'].replace\(\\"'\\", \\"\\\\\\\\'\\" \)
    url_link = item['url_link'].replace\(\\"'\\", \\"\\\\\\\\'\\" \)
    image_url = item['image_url_external'].replace\(\\"'\\", \\"\\\\\\\\'\\" \)
    php_items.append\(f\\"            ['name' => '{name}', 'url_link' => '{url_link}', 'image_url_external' => '{image_url}'],\\"\)
print\('\\n'.join\(php_items[:5]\)\)
print\('...'\)
print\(f'Total: {len\(php_items\)}'\)
")
